bullets: SPACE-SAVING LONGBACK CHAIR FOR RUGGED TERRAINS - Tried and tested to withstand the most extreme climates, Crazy Creek's HEX 2.0 LongBack Chair has extra width and back height, to ensure more expansive comfort. Features a practical and functional design that provides ultralight seating no matter the environment. *Logo placement may vary

VERSATILE, TAKE IT WHEREVER YOU GO - It rolls up compactly to only 4" diameter and fits easily in your bag. Can be used in multiple terrains from sand, gravel, dirt and more, its also great as a stadium seat. Suitable for camping, day hikes, picnics, pool parties, or a day at the beach.

ADJUST TO YOUR COMFORT - Features tight-knit straps with adjustable Rock Lockster (R) buckles on both sides that can turn your chair into a recliner, allowing you to rest your back in between adventures. With 250 lbs weight capacity, it provides maximum support & stability. Available in 3 sizes! Original, LongBack and PowerLounger

WATER-RESISTANT - The outer shell of 210D coated ripstop nylon protects from wet ground and the inner shell of 70D coated ripstop nylon provides ample insulation, and is totally sealed from sand and dirt. Perfect for mountains, riverbanks, beaches and campsites.

35 YEARS OF OUTDOOR SEATING - Constructed with improved 8mm high-density cored EVA closed-cell foam padding for comfort without the added bulk, and virtually unbreakable carbon-fiber support stays, this camping chair is built to withstand the test of time, which is why we offer a LIFETIME WARRANTY!
